ZEC.P.1.18-21.text: The Vision of the Horns and the Craftsmen

ZEC.P.2.1-5.text: The Vision of the Measuring Line

ZEC.P.3.1-10.text: The Vision of Joshua the High Priest

ZEC.P.4.1-14.text: The Vision of the Lampstand and Olive Trees

ZEC.P.5.1-4.text: The Vision of the Flying Scroll

ZEC.P.5.5-11.text: The Vision of the Woman in a Basket

ZEC.P.6.1-8.text: The Vision of the Four Chariots

ZEC.P.7.1-14.text: A Call to Justice and Mercy

ZEC.P.9.14-17.text: The LORD Will Save His People

ZEC.P.10.1-12.text: Judah and Israel Will Be Restored

ZEC.P.13.7-9.text: The Shepherd Struck, the Sheep Scattered

ZEC.P.14.16-21.text: All Nations Will Worship the King

ZEC.1.1-3.text: The LORD tells Zechariah to call the people to return

ZEC.1.4-6.text: The fathers ignored the prophets, then repented

ZEC.1.7-9.text: Zechariah sees a man on a red horse among myrtle trees

ZEC.1.10-11.text: The riders report that the earth is at rest

ZEC.1.12-13.text: The angel asks the LORD to show mercy to Jerusalem

ZEC.1.14-15.text: The LORD is jealous for Jerusalem, angry with nations

ZEC.1.16-17.text: The LORD promises to return and rebuild Jerusalem

ZEC.1.18-19.text: Zechariah sees four horns that scattered Judah

ZEC.1.20-21.text: Four craftsmen come to throw down the horns

ZEC.2.1-2.text: Zechariah sees a man who will measure Jerusalem

ZEC.2.3-5.text: The LORD will be a wall of fire around Jerusalem

ZEC.2.6-7.text: The LORD tells the people to flee from Babylon

ZEC.2.8-9.text: The LORD will punish nations that plundered his people

ZEC.2.10-11.text: The LORD comes to live among the people of Zion

ZEC.2.12-13.text: The LORD will choose Jerusalem again; all must be silent

ZEC.3.1-3.text: Satan accuses Joshua, but the LORD rebukes Satan

ZEC.3.4-5.text: The LORD removes Joshua’s sin and gives him clean clothes

ZEC.3.6-7.text: The LORD promises Joshua authority if he obeys

ZEC.3.8-9.text: The LORD promises to bring his servant, the Branch

ZEC.3.10-10.text: On that day neighbors will sit under vine and fig tree

ZEC.4.1-3.text: Zechariah sees a gold lampstand and two olive trees

ZEC.4.4-5.text: Zechariah asks the angel what these things are

ZEC.4.6-7.text: The LORD tells Zerubbabel success comes by his Spirit

ZEC.4.8-11.text: The LORD says Zerubbabel will finish the house

ZEC.4.12-13.text: Zechariah asks about the olive branches and gold pipes

ZEC.4.14-14.text: The two olive trees are the two anointed ones

ZEC.5.3-4.text: The scroll is a curse on thieves and false swearers

ZEC.5.5-7.text: Zechariah sees a basket with a woman inside

ZEC.5.8-9.text: The woman Wickedness is shut in the basket

ZEC.5.10-11.text: Two women carry the basket to build a house in Shinar

ZEC.6.1-4.text: Zechariah sees four chariots between two mountains

ZEC.6.5-6.text: The angel tells Zechariah where the chariots go

ZEC.6.7-8.text: The LORD sends the horses to patrol the earth

ZEC.6.9-11.text: God tells Zechariah to make a crown for Joshua

ZEC.6.12-13.text: The Branch will build the LORD’s temple and rule

ZEC.6.14-15.text: The crown stays in the temple as a memorial

ZEC.7.1-3.text: Men from Bethel ask whether to keep fasting

ZEC.7.4-7.text: The LORD asks if the people fasted for him

ZEC.7.8-10.text: The LORD tells the people to be just and kind

ZEC.7.11-12.text: The people refused to listen, so the LORD was angry

ZEC.7.13-14.text: The LORD scatters the people who would not listen

ZEC.8.1-3.text: The LORD will return to Zion and live in Jerusalem

ZEC.8.4-5.text: Old people and children will fill Jerusalem’s streets

ZEC.8.6-8.text: The LORD will bring his people home to Jerusalem

ZEC.8.9-10.text: The LORD urges the temple builders to be strong

ZEC.8.11-12.text: The LORD will give the remaining people good harvests

ZEC.8.13-15.text: The LORD will make Judah and Israel a blessing

ZEC.8.16-17.text: The LORD tells the people to be truthful and fair

ZEC.8.18-19.text: Judah’s fasts will become joyful feasts

ZEC.8.20-22.text: Many peoples will come to Jerusalem to seek the LORD

ZEC.8.23-23.text: Ten men from the nations will want to go with a Jew

ZEC.9.1-2.text: The LORD speaks against Hadrach, Damascus, Tyre and Sidon

ZEC.9.3-4.text: The LORD will destroy Tyre and its wealth

ZEC.9.5-7.text: The LORD will humble the Philistine cities

ZEC.9.8-8.text: The LORD will guard his house and his people

ZEC.9.9-10.text: Zion’s humble King comes and brings peace to the nations

ZEC.9.11-13.text: The LORD will free the prisoners and make Judah strong

ZEC.9.14-15.text: The LORD will appear and shield his people in battle

ZEC.9.16-17.text: The LORD will save his people like a flock

ZEC.10.1-2.text: The people should ask the LORD for rain, not idols

ZEC.10.3-3.text: The LORD will punish the leaders and care for Judah

ZEC.10.4-5.text: Judah will produce strong rulers who win in battle

ZEC.10.6-7.text: The LORD promises to strengthen and save Judah and Joseph

ZEC.10.8-10.text: The LORD will bring his scattered people back home

ZEC.10.11-12.text: The LORD will strengthen his people and humble Assyria

ZEC.11.1-3.text: Trees and shepherds cry out because the land is ruined

ZEC.11.4-6.text: The LORD will no longer pity the people of the land

ZEC.11.7-9.text: The prophet pastures the flock but then rejects it

ZEC.11.10-12.text: The prophet breaks the staff Favor and asks for his wages

ZEC.11.13-14.text: The prophet throws thirty silver pieces to the potter

ZEC.11.15-16.text: The LORD will raise up a foolish shepherd over the land

ZEC.11.17-17.text: The LORD declares judgment on the worthless shepherd

ZEC.12.1-3.text: The LORD will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for the nations

ZEC.12.4-5.text: The LORD will protect Judah and strike the enemy horses

ZEC.12.6-6.text: Judah’s clans will destroy the nations like fire

ZEC.12.7-9.text: The LORD will save Judah first and defend Jerusalem

ZEC.12.10-11.text: The LORD will give Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer

ZEC.12.12-14.text: Every clan in the land will mourn on its own

ZEC.13.1-2.text: The LORD will cleanse Jerusalem and remove idols

ZEC.13.3-3.text: Parents will put false prophets to death

ZEC.13.4-6.text: False prophets will be ashamed and deny being prophets

ZEC.13.7-7.text: The LORD commands the sword to strike his Shepherd

ZEC.13.8-9.text: The LORD will refine the remaining third of the people

ZEC.14.1-2.text: The LORD will gather the nations to attack Jerusalem

ZEC.14.3-4.text: The LORD will fight and stand on the Mount of Olives

ZEC.14.5-5.text: The people will flee through the valley as the LORD comes

ZEC.14.6-8.text: Living water will flow out from Jerusalem

ZEC.14.9-11.text: The LORD will be King over all the earth

ZEC.14.12-13.text: The LORD will strike Jerusalem’s enemies with a plague

ZEC.14.14-15.text: Judah will fight and collect the wealth of the nations

ZEC.14.16-18.text: Nations must go up to Jerusalem to worship the King

ZEC.14.19-19.text: Egypt and other nations will be punished for not coming

ZEC.14.20-21.text: Everything in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD
